text:
maya: hey all — starting today! a couple of quick setup asks: 1) Figma team access seems limited (can't see components in DS library) 2) where's the canonical roadmap doc for Q2 product bets? 3) how do i reserve the research lab + request participant incentives? also who handles dev laptop stickers? :)
sam: welcome maya! for Figma DS library you need to be on the `design:product` team. i just sent an invite to maya@redwood.ai. once you accept, toggle "Libraries" in the file browser.
maya: accepted, can now open the DS file but still seeing old tokens in the shared styles. are we on new token names yet?
rachel: we migrated tokens last month — prefix is `rwd-` now. if you see legacy names open the DS file and click "Update styles" (should prompt). ping me if it doesn't.
design-ops-bot: Token migration note: Tokens prefixed with `rwd-` are the source of truth. If you need write access to the DS file, request via `/access request design-system` and include your github handle.
pm-ops: roadmap lives in Notion under Product -> Roadmaps -> Q2 Bets: https://notion.so/redwood/product-roadmap-q2. PMs have edit access by default; if you need commenting only, say so.
maya: thanks — added a quick sprint-0 note under "onboarding flow".
sam: for the research lab booking, use the shared calendar (Research -> Lab Bookings). if you need study credit budget, @research-ops handles incentives (file a request in that channel with dates and cohort size).
maya: good to know. small process q: who pairs with PMs for initial discovery sessions? want to join one this week if possible.
pm-ops: normally product designers pair with the PM on day 2-3. i've added you to my calendar for a 30m sync tomorrow — drop any specific asks in the doc and we'll go through them.
rachel: sticker/laptop swag — @people-ops manages shipments. ping people-ops with mailing address. bonus tip: ping #random for intro and we'll send a virtual welcome sticker pack.
sam: one more trick: name your prototype files `proto/<team>-<feature>-v1` (kebab-case) so search works across teams.
maya: awesome, everything's flowing now. big thanks y'all :heart:
